from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
import numpy as np
rw=Chem.RWMol(); pos=[]; groups={}
def atom(el, xy=(0,0),charge=0):
 a=Chem.Atom(el);a.SetFormalCharge(charge); i=rw.AddAtom(a);pos.append(xy);return i
def bond(a,b,order=Chem.BondType.SINGLE): rw.AddBond(a,b,order)
# central quinonediimine C6H4: bottom left, bottom right, right bottom-top -> around upper edge
central=[atom('C',q) for q in [(724,284),(843,317),(928,233),(899,121),(784,88),(699,164)]]
for j in range(6):bond(central[j],central[(j+1)%6],Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if j in (2,4) else Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
sb=atom('Sb',(720,630),-2)
for side,cidx,ringpts,npt,opt,tbu_at in [
 ('left',0,[(481,582),(510,463),(423,381),(311,413),(286,528),(364,613)],(635,395),(541,716),(3,5)),
 ('right',1,[(1030,560),(994,449),(1071,360),(1185,381),(1221,496),(1148,586)],(881,467),(912,638),(3,5))]:
 ring=[atom('C',q) for q in ringpts];groups[side]=ring
 for j in range(6): bond(ring[j],ring[(j+1)%6],Chem.BondType.AROMATIC)
 for idx in ring: rw.GetAtomWithIdx(idx).SetIsAromatic(True)
 for j in (3,5):
  root=atom('C',(ringpts[j][0]+(-60 if side=='left' else 60),ringpts[j][1]+(-50 if j==3 else 65)))
  bond(ring[j],root)
  for k in range(3):
   import math
   ang=2*math.pi*k/3
   m=atom('C',(pos[root][0]+75*math.cos(ang),pos[root][1]+75*math.sin(ang)))
   bond(root,m)
 n=atom('N',npt,+1); o=atom('O',opt)
 bond(n,ring[1]);bond(o,ring[0]);bond(n,central[cidx],Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
 bond(sb,n);bond(sb,o)
 groups[side+'n']=n;groups[side+'o']=o
# three phenyls
for z,(rx,ry) in enumerate(((729,498),(730,795),(875,752))):
 import math
 ph=[]
 # first phenyl ring pseudo geometry in x-y
 for j in range(6):
  theta=2*math.pi*j/6
  ph.append(atom('C',(rx+72*math.cos(theta),ry+72*math.sin(theta))))
 for j in range(6):bond(ph[j],ph[(j+1)%6],Chem.BondType.AROMATIC)
 for a in ph:rw.GetAtomWithIdx(a).SetIsAromatic(True)
 bond(sb,ph[0]); groups['phenyl'+str(z)]=ph
m=rw.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
print('n atoms',m.GetNumAtoms(), 'n heavy',len(pos),'formula',Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m),flush=True)
for seed in [5, 29, 51]:
 param=AllChem.ETKDGv3();param.randomSeed=seed;param.maxIterations=200;param.useRandomCoords=True
 res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,param)
 print('embed',seed,res,flush=True)
 if res==0: break
if res!=0: raise ValueError('embedding failed')
print('Sb positions',[ (j,m.GetAtomWithIdx(j).GetSymbol(), m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(sb,j).GetBondType() if m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(sb,j) else None) for j in range(m.GetNumAtoms()) if m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(sb,j)],flush=True)
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'initial.mol')
Chem.MolToXYZFile(m,'initial.xyz')
PY

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import math
rw=Chem.RWMol()
def atom(el,charge=0):
 a=Chem.Atom(el);a.SetFormalCharge(charge)
 if el in ('Sb','O','N'): a.SetNoImplicit(True)
 return rw.AddAtom(a)
def bond(i,j,o=Chem.BondType.SINGLE): rw.AddBond(i,j,o)
c=[atom('C') for i in range(6)]
for j in range(6):bond(c[j],c[(j+1)%6],Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if j in (2,4) else Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
sb=atom('Sb',-2)
for central_idx in (0,1):
 r=[atom('C') for _ in range(6)]
 for j in range(6):bond(r[j],r[(j+1)%6],Chem.BondType.AROMATIC);rw.GetAtomWithIdx(r[j]).SetIsAromatic(True)
 for j in (3,5):
  root=atom('C');bond(r[j],root)
  for k in range(3):bond(root,atom('C'))
 n=atom('N',+1);o=atom('O')
 bond(n,r[1]);bond(o,r[0]);bond(n,c[central_idx],Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
 bond(sb,n,Chem.BondType.ZERO);bond(sb,o,Chem.BondType.ZERO)
for p in range(3):
 ph=[atom('C') for _ in range(6)]
 for j in range(6):bond(ph[j],ph[(j+1)%6],Chem.BondType.AROMATIC);rw.GetAtomWithIdx(ph[j]).SetIsAromatic(True)
 bond(sb,ph[0])
m=rw.GetMol();Chem.SanitizeMol(m);m=Chem.AddHs(m)
print(Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m),m.GetNumAtoms(),flush=True)
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3();params.randomSeed=5;params.useRandomCoords=True;params.maxIterations=200
assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)==0
Chem.MolToXYZFile(m,'initial.xyz')
